title: A test is skipped with no expiry: reason="temporarily disabled 2026-05-02 - flaky?"
evidence: eval/fixtures/pricer_rev_b/test_pricer.py:17 — skip marker with reason 'reason="temporarily disabled 2026-05-02 - flaky?"'; no date or expiry in the reason
found by a regular expression over the test files, not by a model

root_cause.mechanism: A skip with no expiry is a deleted test that nobody decided to delete: it never runs again and no one is told.

narrative: A skipped test with no expiry silently removes coverage. Either give the skip an expiry date or delete the test deliberately.
